parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of the 'center' kwarg being ignored when manually iterating over DataArrayRolling. The changes are minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments to explain the logic for calculating 'starts' and 'stops' when 'center' is True.
